source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Use the inspectionTool to simulate the accessibility inspection by clicking on each access feature on your building. (You need Google Chrome for this to work - if you do not have Google Chrome you may get a message telling you to download the latest version of Google Chrome)
   - This will populate the checklists on the left with the correct access features.
3. Click on the inspection and download the PDF.

4. If the accessibility check fails:
   1. Open up the inspection record PDF
   2. Attach a screenshot of the screenshot of the accessibility check of that feature (as well as any access feature with an issue) in the appropriate update field of the inspection PDF
   3. If any access features are blank, check `Don't know`**
   4. If you can determine why the access issue is failing, also describe the issue as well in the updates field as well.
   5. Save the PDF.
